Ed25519 edge-case vectors (ed25519vectors.json)

Used by tests/test_roam_sig.py. The roaming profile (spec v0.3 §15.2) accepts
exactly the vectors with no flags: canonical encodings and points of prime order
only, so every implementation (Python, the viewer, the relay) agrees.
